critical_code_review_comments: (Carried over from iter 12, still applies) Sidebar renders twice in DOM (desktop persistent + mobile drawer) with identical data-testid — Playwright must loop .nth() + is_visible() to click sidebar-link-*. Consider suffixing testids (e.g. sidebar-link-{key}-mobile) so strict-mode selectors remain unique.

Copy-week endpoint's anti-doublon uses exact (title, shift, date) match — if an admin edits a task title between copies, a duplicate would be created. Consider tracking source task id via 'source_id' on copies for stronger idempotency.
